description_en: Queries the number of connections to an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 返回目标AnalyticDB MySQL版集群当前的连接数
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-connection-count-records --db-cluster-id am-bp1jj9xqft1po0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeConnectionCountRecords

parameters.description_en:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to view the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region. These details include the cluster ID.
